$doc: Per-line expectations for Test-LocalSync.ps1, so the script file itself stays identical
between nbidal18-vanilla-plus and nbidal18-vanilla-plus-plus - the same reason
RELEASE-PREFIX.txt, PACK-NAME.txt and SERVER.txt exist. Before this file the test asserted
Vanilla+ facts outright: both servers in servers.dat, the v1.0.106 hardcore move, and a
config probe on a mod the hardcore line removes. All three failed here, correctly, and none
of them was a bug in the pack.
This is the HARDCORE copy. The Vanilla+ copy lists both addresses, carries the hardcore
move under serverListSeed, and probes config/immersive_aircraft.json.
$serversDoc: Every address that must be in servers.dat after a sync. Since hardcore v1.0.2 the client ships
BOTH servers, on purpose (owner, 2026-09-24): a hardcore client cannot log in to Vanilla+ - the
manifest digests differ - but the entry, drawn red by Better Compatibility Checker, tells a
player the other server exists and needs the other pack. Hardcore first, Vanilla+ second.
$seedDoc: The updater's ServerListSeed this line ships, or null. Hardcore v1.0.2 adds the Vanilla+ entry to
instances imported while the list carried the hardcore server alone (v1.0.0 and v1.0.1). An
`added` seed has no previous address, so previous is null: the test removes the entry from its
fresh instance and expects the updater to append it and write the marker. Vanilla+ instead ships
a `moved` seed with previous set, and the test rolls its instance back to that old address.
$worldFolderDoc: The server address whose per-world folders the retirement sweep is checked against - Voxy's
LOD store under .voxy/saves/<addr>_<port> and Xaero's map tiles under Multiplayer_<addr>.
Each line checks its own server, because that is the one its players actually have.
$configProbeDoc: A published config file the test plants a deliberately wrong stub of, to prove the updater
replaces a support-class file an existing instance already had rather than leaving the
player's stale copy. null skips the probe.
Vanilla+ uses config/immersive_aircraft.json and checks useCustomKeybindSystem goes back to
false. The hardcore line removes Immersive Aircraft, so that file is not published here and
the probe would assert against a file that cannot exist. Replaced with lambdynlights.toml,
which is support class on this line and published.

configProbe.stub:
# planted by Test-LocalSync; the updater must replace this whole file
mode = "OFF"
configProbe.failIfStale: an instance that already had lambdynlights.toml kept the planted stub - a support-class config an existing player has is not being restored
configProbe.failIfMissing: lambdynlights.toml was not replaced by the published copy - only the planted stub is there
configProbe.ok: published lambdynlights.toml replaced, so support config reaches an instance that already had it
